source.name: Static
source.originalDescription: Upon receiving damage: paralyzes all nearby opposing Pokémon (30s CD). Paralysis from Static decreases opposing Pokémon movement speed by 30% and reduces auto attack speed by a flat 10% for 2s.

source.name: Thunderstorm Aerial
source.originalDescription: Creates a star-shaped zone of electricity in the designated area for 4s, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect when created, then damaging opposing Pokémon over time (up to 5 times) and decreasing their movement speed by 60% while in the zone. If the user hits an opposing Pokémon that is in the zone with an auto attack, the next basic attack becomes a boosted attack. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Thunderstorm Aerial は 移動速度を下げる、シールドを付与する、次の通常攻撃または強化攻撃を準備する、通常攻撃回数により強化攻撃になる。
